scope: frozen public acquisition/materializer API and recorded host tools/capabilities only

api_findings.new_acquirer: hardwires LocalMaterializer; injector fields are private
api_findings.materializer_interface: public interface, accepted by Execute/ExecuteWithStreams, not configurable through public NewAcquirer
api_findings.default_materialization: portable HTFS catalog is rebased then restored to regular Holotree target; compatibility verified and ready record written
api_findings.execution: lease-bound, resolves executable and cwd from ready materialization

host_barriers.fuse: kernel registered but /dev/fuse absent per retained capability receipt
host_barriers.loop: no /dev/loop device for inspected loop-mount route per retained capability receipt
host_barriers.userspace_tools: recorded host tool inspection found bwrap only among compressed-image/COW candidates; no SquashFS/EROFS image utilities

existing_archive_path: WriteArchive uses ZIP Store entries; ImportArchive validates and streams gzip objects into ordinary local CAS before NewAcquirer/Execute; legacy ZipLibrary RestoreTo gunzips and eagerly restores regular files
existing_archive_path_classification: archive transport/import or eager extraction only; not a mounted image or COW
rejected_substitute: archive compression plus eager extraction is not a mounted image or COW
next_feasible_independent_work: read-only attribution of retained CPU profiles to local CAS/open/stat/import/HTFS restore/compatibility costs; no replay
measurement_admission_controls: artifact/index/image cryptographic identity and bounded canonical paths
logical file hashes and relocation parity
immutable lower and independent writable upper
strict owner/mode boundaries and mounted-view compatibility verification
execution lease tied to mount lifetime; crash cleanup and stale mount/upper absence
